notes: «أن خالته، أخبرته عن امرأة» : the aunt is named only by relation; «امرأة» is the unnamed woman whose words («قالت بينا أبي ...») are the saying.
The father in the story («أبي») is in the scene, not a link.
«قالت هي مصدقة امرأة صدق» is an assessment inside the report, not a name; it is left out of the chain.
